name: Jean Marten
source:
The Captain of the ship, hired by Viardo.
He loves his job, the sea and the women. He is a womanizer and a brave sailor.
In spite of his interest to women, he hasn't opened his heart to anyone yet.
Strong, experienced and reliable, as firm as a rock.
He relies on himself and his knowledge, not superstitions.
He plays the lute secretly.
